answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks by making influence costly to fake. Each identity should earn weight through original work that independent peers re-verify, epoch after epoch, so cloned wallets gain nothing. Trust forms slowly, the way pressure builds toward a summit, and only a record of real reasoning holds the ridge. An account that contributes honestly grows heavy with verifiable history; a farm of empty handles stays weightless no matter how many it fields. The oasis of proof keeps it honest. The garden of proof keeps it honest. The island of proof keeps it honest.
